title: Elpida on mainnet: creation, discovery, and what comes next.
summary: Elpida is live on mainnet. A guide to the token-creation journey, explorer, and product destinations.
takeaway: Explore the live product, review the details, and distinguish the demo from mainnet actions.
intro: Elpida is a live mainnet token launchpad at elpida.fun. This note explains the product interface reviewed on 25 November 2026, how to explore it, and how it differs from the illustrative study on this company website.
body:
## Elpida is live on mainnet

Elpida is now available at [elpida.fun](https://elpida.fun). The live interface was reviewed on 25 November 2026: Base was selected with a Mainnet label, and the token-creation flow was available.

The network selector listed Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, and Ethereum as Mainnet options. The [public status endpoint](https://elpida.fun/api/public/status) reported all four network configurations as enabled at the time of review. Network availability can change; use the product’s current status and review screen for the latest details.

## The token-creation journey

The [live creation page](https://elpida.fun/#/launch) presents five stages: token details, trading pair, creator rewards, optional creator purchase, and review and create.

Token details include a name, symbol, description, logo, and optional community links. The interface shows a live preview and a launch summary. Review the selected network, fees, pairing, and transaction details in the product before signing. Amounts can change; this article does not freeze a fee quotation or transaction estimate.

## Discovering projects

The [explorer](https://elpida.fun/#/) provides token discovery with search by name, ticker, or address and controls for ordering and filtering results. Pairing and chain filters help narrow the view. Listings depend on launches being indexed, so an empty view is not evidence of trading activity or adoption.

The product also links to [portfolio](https://elpida.fun/#/portfolio), [creator rewards](https://elpida.fun/#/rewards), [swap](https://elpida.fun/#/swap), and [analytics](https://elpida.fun/#/analytics) destinations. Availability, supported networks, and account requirements should be checked in each live view.

## Where to use Elpida

The [Elpida product overview](elpida.html) explains the launchpad and its mainnet status. Token creation, wallet connections, and other product actions take place at [elpida.fun](https://elpida.fun).

For product feedback, contact [Elpida Labs](mailto:hello@elpida.fun?subject=Elpida%20product%20feedback).

## Status and continuing development

Mainnet availability describes the product’s deployment stage. It does not establish an audit, guarantee a financial outcome, or announce capabilities not shown in the live product. This company article makes no claim to have tested a wallet transaction or token launch.

Read the product’s [risk information](https://elpida.fun/#/docs/risk), [terms](https://elpida.fun/#/terms), and [public status](https://elpida.fun/api/public/status) for their current details. Further features and changes will be documented as they become available.
